distanceRationale: Mathlib has smooth morphisms and equation-level reduction types of Weierstrass curves, and Tau Ceti has abelian varieties over a field, DVR models of curves and the combinatorial Picard group of a fibre's intersection matrix. There are no abelian schemes, Néron models or smoothening, no Tate modules of abelian varieties, and no semiabelian schemes, Raynaud extensions or generalised Jacobians. The targets (BLR, SGA 7 IX, Faltings–Chai degeneration) need several research-level layers on top of the missing abelian-scheme and formal-geometry theory.

distanceRationale: Mathlib supplies generic Ore localization, Weierstrass preparation for power series and continuous group cohomology, and Tau Ceti has K₀ of abelian categories. There are no completed group rings of p-adic Lie groups, no K₁ or relative K₀ of rings with localization sequences, no reduced norms or SK₁, no commutative main conjecture and no p-adic L-functions of totally real fields. The targets are Kakde's and Ritter–Weiss's equivariant main conjectures, extended by uniqueness results from 2025–2026: frontier theorems resting on many unbuilt theories.

distanceRationale: Tau Ceti has classical Hecke, U_p and diamond operators on Γ₀(N)/Γ₁(N) forms and eigenforms, but there are no ordinary projectors, Iwasawa/weight-space algebras, Hilbert modular forms, Galois representations attached to modular forms, deformation rings, pseudorepresentations or patching. Hida theory and the Skinner–Wiles residually reducible R=T theorems sit on top of all of these, together with p-adic Hodge input (Berger–Li–Zhu).

distanceRationale: Tau Ceti has Huber rings and the adic spectrum Spa with rational subsets and a structure presheaf, and Mathlib has ring-level perfectoid constructions such as θ and B_dR^+. There are no adic or perfectoid spaces, no Hodge–Tate period map, no Hilbert modular varieties or forms, no weight spaces or locally analytic representations and no toroidal compactifications. The endpoint (Birkbeck–Heuer–Williams 2023, compared with Andreatta–Iovita–Pilloni) is recent research resting on all of these.

distanceRationale: Tau Ceti supplies the linear-algebra and group inputs: polarized Hodge structures, the split symplectic group scheme with its reductivity, and isogenies of abelian varieties over a field. There are no algebraic spaces or stacks and no Artin representability, no abelian schemes with polarizations, Rosati involutions or level structures, no Weil pairings, no deformation theory of abelian schemes and no Shimura varieties. Lan's and Kottwitz's constructions need several research-level layers on top of these missing foundations.
